subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw make `parseJsonlEvent` and its normalized display-event union a supported public `CliBackendPlugin` API, rather than keeping JSONL tool-card parsing limited to built-in dialects?
rationale: The implementation follows the plugin-owned parsing boundary, but only an owner can decide the long-term SDK contract, event vocabulary, and compatibility commitment for external plugins.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK hook
options.body: Adopt the opt-in plugin-owned parser hook after a current-main refresh and proof from a real registered external backend.

options.title: Keep JSONL parsing built-in only
options.body: Decline this new public API and close or redirect the feature request until a smaller approved extension seam is defined.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK hook
recommendation.body: Adopt the opt-in plugin-owned parser hook after a current-main refresh and proof from a real registered external backend.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties obviyus directly to the CLI parser, thinking, and native tool-event paths this contract would extend.
